captions.caption: Soldiers exit the open rear cargo ramp of a large military transport aircraft.

Several soldiers walk down the metal ramp of the military plane onto the tarmac.
Soldiers carrying gear walk away from the aircraft as more personnel prepare inside.
A group of soldiers finishes descending the ramp of the military transport plane.
Military personnel walk on the tarmac next to the large open cargo plane.
A soldier in the foreground walks past the open rear of the transport aircraft.
A cargo loader vehicle approaches the rear ramp of a large military transport plane.
Personnel monitor the cargo loader as it aligns with the aircraft's rear ramp.
A military specialist stands on the aircraft ramp, directing the incoming cargo loader.
The cargo loader carries a palletized load toward the open rear of the transport plane.
Ground crew members watch as the cargo loader approaches the aircraft ramp.
The loader vehicle positions its platform to transfer cargo onto the plane's ramp.
A loadmaster on the ramp signals to the cargo loader operator.
The cargo loader's platform begins to move cargo into the aircraft's hold.
Inside the aircraft, soldiers secure a Humvee with heavy metal chains.
Two soldiers sit on the floor while another inspects the Humvee's front chain.
A soldier checks the tension on the chains securing the vehicle to the floor.
Personnel ensure the military vehicle is properly fastened inside the cargo hold.
A forklift drives away from the open nose of a C-5 Galaxy transport plane.
Several personnel stand near the front ramp of the massive military cargo aircraft.
A forklift maneuvers near the front of the aircraft under the raised nose section.
Soldiers and ground crew watch as equipment is moved near the transport plane.

The forklift completes placing a cargo pallet inside the C-5 Galaxy's nose.
Personnel walk around the front ramp area as the forklift pulls away.
A ground crew member walks toward the front of the large military transport plane.
At night, personnel carry gear toward the open side door of a military aircraft.
Soldiers with bags walk across the dark tarmac toward the transport plane.
Personnel board the aircraft via a side ladder under bright floodlights.
A line of soldiers carries personal equipment toward the lit aircraft at night.
Ground crew members walk near the massive landing gear of the transport plane.
Inside the brightly lit cargo hold, soldiers walk across the metal floor.
Military personnel move through the spacious interior of the transport aircraft.
Soldiers prepare the cargo area for transport while walking along the floor tracks.
Personnel in flight suits coordinate activities inside the large cargo bay.
A soldier examines the tie-down points on the floor of the aircraft.
Soldiers stand near a Humvee inside the cargo hold, one holding a folded flag.
A soldier with an American flag patch on his sleeve looks toward the rear.
Personnel converse near a secured military vehicle inside the transport plane.
From outside at night, the open rear ramp of a transport plane shows a Humvee inside.
A soldier walks down the rear ramp of the aircraft onto the night tarmac.
Personnel stand on the ramp and tarmac as the aircraft is prepared for departure.
The large cargo plane's interior is visible through the wide-open rear ramp at night.
Ground crew members move around the tail section of the transport aircraft.
A group of soldiers pushes a large, netted cargo pallet into the aircraft.
Personnel work together to slide a heavy cargo container along the floor rollers.
Soldiers in desert tan uniforms maneuver the cargo pallet toward its storage position.
The team of soldiers pushes the cargo container deeper into the plane's hold.
Military personnel continue to move the large pallet along the internal tracking system.
A soldier watches as the cargo container is positioned correctly in the bay.
Personnel use their body weight to push the heavy palletized equipment.
Soldiers guide the cargo container as it rolls into place inside the aircraft.
The team finishes moving the cargo pallet into its designated spot.
A soldier reaches down to secure the straps on a large cargo container.
Personnel work on fastening the netting and straps around the palletized load.
A female soldier in a military uniform inspects the cargo netting on the side.
Several soldiers collaborate to tighten the straps on a tall cargo pallet.
Personnel ensure all cargo is tightly secured for flight inside the transport bay.
